name: toknt-monorepo
description: Tokn't — local-first token optimization layer for AI coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @toknt/cache && npm run build -w @toknt/tokenizer && npm run build -w @toknt/core && npm run build -w @toknt/optimizer && npm run build -w @toknt/adapters && npm run build -w @toknt/benchmark && npm run build -w toknt && npm run build -w @toknt/integration-claude && npm run build -w @toknt/integration-cursor && npm run build -w @toknt/integration-codex && npm run build -w @toknt/integration-windsurf && npm run build -w @toknt/observatory
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node apps/cli/dist/index.js benchmark
